title: Doubby dôr
info: Carton packaging for Doubby dôr, a 200 g Dubai-style pistachio chocolate, designed in two colourways, pistachio and deep green, so the range reads as one family on shelf.

value.title: Challenge
paragraphs: Dubai-style pistachio chocolate is a crowded, trend-driven category. The pack had to make the product’s filling and indulgence obvious at a glance, while giving the brand its own recognisable look.

value.title: Solution
paragraphs: The front leads with the Doubby dôr mark and a chocolate splash that flows into a cut-through photo of the pistachio-filled bar, over a geometric pattern. A script “Chocolat dubaï” runs along the side panel, and the back carries ingredients in English and Arabic, the nutrition table, barcode and recycling symbols.
Keeping the layout identical and changing only the background colour lets each variant stand out while the two cartons clearly belong together.
